text: 中信建投研报表示，7月稀土各品种表现差异明显，氧化镨钕先扬后抑，氧化铽跳涨后回调，氧化镝整体平稳。供给端，由于废料厂原料紧张问题导致产量明显下滑，据上海有色网，7月氧化镨钕产量环比下降11%，8月或有边际改善，但总体产量仍被压制。下游高温假期导致电机厂开工下滑，需求回落，8月仍处淡季，金九银十是传统消费旺季，市场对需求启动预期依然较强，8月中下旬有望重启下游备库，打破供需双弱格局，推动价格企稳向上。
text_en: CSC research report says July rare earth varieties showed diverging performance, praseodymium neodymium oxide rose then fell, terbium oxide jumped then corrected, dysprosium oxide was stable. On supply, scrap feedstock shortages caused notable output decline; per Shanghai Metals Market, July praseodymium neodymium oxide output fell 11% MoM, with possible marginal improvement in August but overall output still suppressed. Downstream summer holidays cut motor plant operations, demand fell; August remains off-season, with golden September and silver October as traditional consumption peak, market expectations for demand recovery remain strong, and late-August may restart downstream restocking, breaking weak supply-demand pattern and pushing prices stable upward.
